add-multi-line-text-watermark-facade.title: Add Multi-Line Text Watermark to PDF
add-multi-line-text-watermark-facade.description: Demonstrates how to create a multi‑line text watermark using FormattedText and apply it to every page of a PDF with Aspose.Pdf.Facades.

rotate-text-stamp-45-degrees.title: Rotate Text Stamp 45 Degrees in PDF
rotate-text-stamp-45-degrees.description: Demonstrates creating a TextStamp, setting a 45° rotation around its center, centering it on each page, and applying it to a PDF using Aspose.Pdf.Facades.

apply-pdf-page-stamp-as-background.title: Apply PDF Page Stamp as Background to All Pages
apply-pdf-page-stamp-as-background.description: Shows how to load a source PDF and a stamp PDF, create a PdfPageStamp from the stamp page, set it as a background, and apply it to every page of the target document.

apply-external-pdf-template-stamp.title: Apply External PDF Stamp to Third Page
apply-external-pdf-template-stamp.description: Demonstrates how to create a PdfFileStamp from an external PDF template and apply it only to the third page of a PDF document using Aspose.Pdf.Facades.

add-lower-roman-page-numbers-odd-pages.title: Add Lower-Roman Page Numbers to Odd Pages
add-lower-roman-page-numbers-odd-pages.description: Demonstrates how to add page numbers in lower‑case Roman numerals to only the odd pages of a PDF using a TextStamp.

combine-image-text-pdf-stamp.title: Add Image and Text Stamps to PDF Pages
combine-image-text-pdf-stamp.description: Demonstrates how to load a PDF, iterate through its pages, and apply both an image stamp (logo) and a text stamp (custom label) with custom positioning and styling, then save the result.

add-header-stamp-to-pdf-pages.title: Add Header Stamp to All PDF Pages
add-header-stamp-to-pdf-pages.description: Shows how to load a PDF with Aspose.Pdf, create a TextStamp as a header, and apply it to every page in the document.

add-footer-date-stamp-to-last-pdf-page.title: Add Footer Date Stamp to Last PDF Page
add-footer-date-stamp-to-last-pdf-page.description: Shows how to insert a footer stamp with the current date (MM-dd-yyyy) on the last page of a PDF using Aspose.Pdf.

apply-rotating-stamps-to-pdf-pages.title: Apply Rotating Image Stamp to Each PDF Page
apply-rotating-stamps-to-pdf-pages.description: Shows how to add an image stamp to every page of a PDF and rotate the stamp by an angle derived from the page index.

add-background-watermark-to-specific-pdf.title: Add Background Text Watermark to Selected PDF Pages
add-background-watermark-to-specific-pdf.description: Demonstrates how to create a semi‑transparent background text stamp and apply it to pages 2 through 5 of a PDF using Aspose.Pdf.

batch-add-multi-line-watermark-to-pdfs.title: Batch Add Multi‑Line Watermark to PDFs
batch-add-multi-line-watermark-to-pdfs.description: Demonstrates how to process a folder of PDF files and apply the same multi‑line text watermark to every page using Aspose.Pdf.

add-image-stamp-to-pdfs-preserve-filenam.title: Add Image Stamp to PDFs and Save to Output Folder
add-image-stamp-to-pdfs-preserve-filenam.description: The example loads each PDF from a source folder, applies an image stamp to every page, and saves the stamped documents to a separate output directory while keeping the original file names.

overlay-legal-disclaimer-with-pdffilesta.title: Add Disclaimer Stamp to First Page of PDFs
overlay-legal-disclaimer-with-pdffilesta.description: Demonstrates how to overlay a legal disclaimer PDF onto the first page of multiple target PDFs using Aspose.Pdf's PdfFileStamp and Stamp classes.

apply-translucent-text-watermark.title: Add Translucent Image Watermark to PDF Pages
apply-translucent-text-watermark.description: Demonstrates creating an ImageStamp, setting its opacity to 50% and applying it to every page of a PDF document using Aspose.Pdf.

apply-rotated-image-stamp-to-pdf-pages.title: Apply Rotated Image Stamp to PDF Pages
apply-rotated-image-stamp-to-pdf-pages.description: Demonstrates how to add an image stamp rotated by 30 degrees to the bottom‑right corner of every page in a PDF using Aspose.Pdf.

add-page-number-stamp-to-pdf.title: Add Dynamic Page Number Text Stamp to PDF
add-page-number-stamp-to-pdf.description: Demonstrates how to create a TextStamp with the {page_number} placeholder and apply it to every page of a PDF, resulting in automatically generated page numbers.

add-multi-line-watermark-custom-font.title: Add Multi‑Line Watermark with Custom Font Size and Color to PDF
add-multi-line-watermark-custom-font.description: Demonstrates loading a PDF from a memory stream, creating a multi‑line text stamp with custom font size and color, and applying it as a semi‑transparent background watermark to every page.

add-footer-stamp-10-points-above-bottom.title: Add Footer Image Stamp 10 Points Above Bottom
add-footer-stamp-10-points-above-bottom.description: Demonstrates how to place an image stamp as a footer exactly 10 points above the bottom edge of each PDF page using Aspose.Pdf.

apply-stamp-to-even-pdf-pages.title: Apply Text Stamp to Even PDF Pages
apply-stamp-to-even-pdf-pages.description: Demonstrates iterating through a PDF document and adding a semi‑transparent "CONFIDENTIAL" text stamp only to even‑numbered pages using Aspose.Pdf.

qr-code-and-text-stamp-for-pdf.title: Stamp QR Code and Verification Text on PDF
qr-code-and-text-stamp-for-pdf.description: Demonstrates how to load a PDF, create an ImageStamp for a QR code and a TextStamp for descriptive text, position them on the first page, and save the stamped document.

apply-text-stamp-to-specific-pdf-pages.title: Apply Image Stamp to Specific PDF Pages
apply-text-stamp-to-specific-pdf-pages.description: Shows how to add an image stamp to selected pages (1, 5, and 10) of a PDF document using Aspose.Pdf.

overlay-image-stamp-on-pdf-pages.title: Overlay Image Stamp on PDF Pages
overlay-image-stamp-on-pdf-pages.description: Demonstrates how to add an image stamp that overlays existing content on every page of a PDF by setting the stamp's Background property to false.

add-transparent-confidential-text-stamp.title: Add Transparent Text Stamp to Selected PDF Pages
add-transparent-confidential-text-stamp.description: Shows how to place a semi‑transparent text stamp (e.g., CONFIDENTIAL) on specific pages of a PDF using Aspose.Pdf.

custom-font-stamp-branding.title: Add Custom Font Stamp to PDF
custom-font-stamp-branding.description: Demonstrates loading a TrueType font from file, creating formatted text with that font, and applying it as a stamp to every page of a PDF using Aspose.Pdf.

add-page-number-stamp-leading-zeros.title: Add Page Number Stamps with Leading Zeros
add-page-number-stamp-leading-zeros.description: Demonstrates how to add Arabic numeral page‑number stamps with leading zeros to every page of a PDF using Aspose.Pdf.

batch-apply-rotated-pdf-stamp.title: Batch Apply Rotated Text Stamp to PDFs
batch-apply-rotated-pdf-stamp.description: Demonstrates iterating over PDF files on a network share, adding a 45‑degree "CONFIDENTIAL" text stamp to every page, and saving the stamped PDFs to an output folder.

multi-line-watermark-addnewlinetext.title: Create Multi-Line Watermark with Different Font Styles
multi-line-watermark-addnewlinetext.description: Demonstrates how to add a three‑line watermark to a PDF using Aspose.Pdf, applying distinct fonts and styles to each line and positioning them vertically.

add-right-aligned-logo-stamp-to-pdf.title: Add Right-Aligned Logo Stamp to PDF
add-right-aligned-logo-stamp-to-pdf.description: Demonstrates how to load a PDF, create an image stamp for a logo, align it to the right margin, and apply it to every page using Aspose.Pdf.

apply-semi-transparent-png-background-st.title: Add Semi-Transparent Background Image Stamp to PDF
apply-semi-transparent-png-background-st.description: Demonstrates how to apply a semi‑transparent PNG as a background stamp that covers the entire page of a PDF using Aspose.Pdf.

add-creation-date-stamp.title: Add Creation Date Stamp to PDF Pages
add-creation-date-stamp.description: Shows how to read a PDF's creation date and add it as a text stamp in the top‑left corner of each page using Aspose.Pdf.

merge-cover-page-background.title: Merge Cover PDF as Background Using PdfFileStamp
merge-cover-page-background.description: Demonstrates how to use Aspose.Pdf's PdfFileStamp and Stamp classes to apply the first page of a cover PDF as a background to every page of a main document, producing a merged PDF.

add-confidential-text-and-logo-stamp.title: Add Image and Text Stamps to PDF Pages
add-confidential-text-and-logo-stamp.description: Demonstrates how to place a company logo image and a bold 'Confidential' text stamp on every page of a PDF using Aspose.Pdf.

apply-custom-line-height-stamp.title: Apply Text Stamp with Custom Line Height to PDF
apply-custom-line-height-stamp.description: Demonstrates adding a multi‑line text watermark to every page of a PDF using a TextStamp with custom line spacing (leading) for equal line spacing.

rotate-text-stamp-on-pdf-pages.title: Apply Rotated Text Stamp and Verify PDF Text
rotate-text-stamp-on-pdf-pages.description: Demonstrates adding a 90‑degree rotated text stamp to each page of a PDF with Aspose.Pdf and verifies that the original document text remains unchanged after stamping.

add-footer-with-page-count.title: Add Footer Stamp with Page Count to PDF
add-footer-with-page-count.description: Shows how to add a footer text stamp that automatically displays the current page number and total page count on each page of a PDF using Aspose.Pdf.

combine-multiple-pdfs-into-multi-page-st.title: Create Multi‑Page PDF Stamp from Multiple PDFs
combine-multiple-pdfs-into-multi-page-st.description: Demonstrates how to combine several single‑page PDF files into a multi‑page stamp and apply it to corresponding pages of a target PDF using Aspose.Pdf.Facades.

add-custom-border-stamp-to-pdf.title: Apply Custom Border Stamp to PDF Pages
add-custom-border-stamp-to-pdf.description: Shows how to add a text annotation with a colored, thick border to each page of a PDF to highlight important sections.

batch-add-rotated-image-stamp-to-first-p.title: Batch Add Rotated Image Stamp to PDFs
batch-add-rotated-image-stamp-to-first-p.description: Iterates through all PDF files in a folder, loads each document, creates an ImageStamp from a PNG, rotates it 45 degrees, adds it to the first page, and saves the stamped PDF to an output directory.

add-file-name-header-stamp-to-pdf.title: Add File Name Header Stamp to PDF
add-file-name-header-stamp-to-pdf.description: Demonstrates how to create a text stamp that shows the source PDF's file name and add it as a centered header on every page using Aspose.Pdf.

add-semi-transparent-background-stamp.title: Add Background Image Stamp with 30% Opacity
add-semi-transparent-background-stamp.description: Demonstrates how to place an image stamp behind the content of each PDF page with 30% opacity, covering the full page size.

add-multi-line-text-watermark.title: Add Multi‑Line Watermark with Varying Font Sizes
add-multi-line-text-watermark.description: Loads a PDF and adds three centered watermark lines—"CONFIDENTIAL", "Do Not Distribute", and "Internal Use Only"—each with a different font size to create visual hierarchy. Uses WatermarkArtifact and TextState to configure font, size, color, rotation, opacity, and position.

stamp-pdf-with-dynamic-barcode.title: Add Dynamic Barcode Stamp to PDF Pages
stamp-pdf-with-dynamic-barcode.description: Demonstrates how to generate a barcode from a document's unique identifier and stamp it onto each page of a PDF using a form textbox field.

apply-rotated-text-stamp-odd-pages.title: Add Rotated Text Stamp to Odd PDF Pages
apply-rotated-text-stamp-odd-pages.description: Loads a PDF, creates a red bold text stamp rotated 30 degrees, and applies it to the left margin of every odd‑numbered page before saving the document.

add-dynamic-text-stamp-to-pdf.title: Add Dynamic Text Stamp to PDF Pages
add-dynamic-text-stamp-to-pdf.description: Demonstrates creating a TextStamp with dynamic content using string interpolation and applying it to every page of a PDF document with Aspose.Pdf.

add-repeating-background-watermark-image.title: Add Repeating Background Image Stamp to PDF
add-repeating-background-watermark-image.description: Demonstrates how to create a single ImageStamp and apply it as a semi‑transparent background watermark on every page of a PDF using Aspose.Pdf.

add-multi-line-colored-header-stamp.title: Add Multi-Line Colored Header Stamp to PDF
add-multi-line-colored-header-stamp.description: Shows how to create a multi-line header stamp with different font colors using Aspose.Pdf and apply it to every page of a PDF document.

add-header-barcode-stamp.title: Add Header Barcode Stamp to PDF Pages
add-header-barcode-stamp.description: Shows how to create a header stamp that inserts a dynamically generated barcode image on each page of a PDF using Aspose.Pdf.

add-multi-line-text-watermark-with-line-.title: Add Multi-Line Text Watermark with Custom Line Spacing
add-multi-line-text-watermark-with-line-.description: Loads a PDF, creates a multi-line TextStamp, sets line spacing to 1.5 × font size, and applies a semi‑transparent watermark to every page.

apply-image-stamp-to-all-pdf-pages__v2.title: Apply Image Stamp to All PDF Pages
apply-image-stamp-to-all-pdf-pages__v2.description: Shows how to load a PDF, create an ImageStamp, and efficiently apply the stamp to every page using the Page.AddStamp method.

add-qr-code-stamp-from-pdf-metadata.title: Add QR Code Stamp from PDF Metadata
add-qr-code-stamp-from-pdf-metadata.description: Shows how to extract a PDF's metadata, generate a QR‑code barcode from it, and place the barcode as a stamp on every page using Aspose.Pdf form fields.
